lessons.description: Seven to ten questions on social media marketing, with an answer key.
lessons.content:
<!-- scaffold -->

> Scaffold. One sample question is written so the format is clear; the remaining
> questions are not written yet.

## Practice questions

Seven to ten questions covering everything in Social Media Marketing, each with an answer key
that explains why the right answer is right.

:::quiz
Q. Why do most brands post different content on LinkedIn and Instagram?
- Posting the same thing twice breaks platform rules
+ The audience, the format and the reason people are there all differ
- LinkedIn does not allow images
= Strategy follows the platform. The same message usually needs a different format and tone on each channel.
:::

## Where to look if you got one wrong

A pointer back to the lesson each question came from.

## The brief

## What to submit

The file, the format and anything that must be shown alongside it.

:::template Submission cover sheet
Name:
Brand:

Deliverable:
Time spent:
What I would do differently with more budget:

## Marking rubric

Marked out of 100. The bands below are placeholders until the assignment is written.

- Research and understanding of the audience — 20 marks
- Correct use of the method taught in this module — 30 marks
- Quality and realism of the deliverable — 30 marks
- Clarity of presentation and reasoning — 20 marks

A pass is 50. Anything that invents data about a real company scores zero on realism.
